text:
Marta: Heads-up — Legal filed an e-discovery request: 24 months of auth + session logs must be "available for inspection". We currently keep 90d raw and 1y redacted. Need a compact, operational pattern: storage tiers, KMS separation, JIT decrypt flow, RBAC, and replay throttles.

Evan: High-level idea: keep 90d hot raw, months 90-730 in cold WORM-style storage (immutable objects) encrypted with a dedicated CMK (evidence-cmk). No routine raw access; raw unwrapping only via ticketed, timeboxed operation.

Riley: Ops constraints: restores can spike SIEM ingest and cost. Proposed default replay throttle = 350 ev/s per tenant. For any single request that will touch >4M events, require manifest-based staged export and SRE coordination. For >30 days of contiguous data, require 2 approvers (security + legal).
\

Marta: Minimal unwrap flow (draft):
1) Request: /evidence-request --tenant=<t> --start=<d> --end=<d> --purpose="eDiscovery" -> creates ticket with id
2) Triage: Security ops verifies scope and sensitivity (SLA 2 business days)
3) Approval: if >30 days or >500k events require 2 approvers; otherwise 1 approver
4) On approval: mint ephemeral decrypt token scoped to evidence-cmk + ticket_id, TTL=4h, limited to object manifest
5) Delivery: either stream to customer SIEM with ingest throttles applied, OR produce presigned GETs (TTL=12m) for secure download
6) Audit: every step, token mint, decrypt actions, delivered bytes written to immutable audit-bucket; evidence bundle includes ticket id, approvers, job_id, objects, bytes, hashes
7) Post-mortem: token auto-revoked at TTL expiry; any out-of-band copy requires a separate ticket and justification

CLI example:
```
/evidence-request --tenant=skyco --start=2023-02-01 --end=2023-03-15 --purpose="legal_evidence"
/evidence-approve REQ-7771 --approver=riley --mfa=true
```

Evan: KMS/key policy notes: restrict kms:Decrypt on evidence-cmk to unwrap-service principal only. Require condition aws:RequestTag/ticket_id present and equal to ticket id; optional require aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true for approvers. Rotate CMK annually, but keep policy history. Store key rotation evidence in audit-bucket.

Riley: RBAC sketch (unique role names): 'evidence_requestor' (open tickets + view scrubbed indices), 'evidence_approver' (approve requests), 'evidence_decrypter' (execute unwraps after approval). Grants to evidence_decrypter must include: linked ticket id, approver signature, MFA flag, and justification text. Day-to-day analysts get 'search_redacted' and cannot request decrypts.

audit-bot: TASK-8773 created: "Evidence access pattern + runbook" assigned to Evan. (automated)

sre-oncall: Operational safeguards:
- For requests estimated >4M events: force staged exports and require off-peak windows (22:00-04:00 UTC)
- Implement backpressure hooks: SIEM connector must return HTTP 429 -> exponential backoff and resume where left off
- Tag every replay with cost_center + ticket_id; chargeback metadata required
- Monitor siem.ingest.latency and pause job if 5xx/429 > 3% across 5m

Marta: Audit retention: keep unwrap/audit records for 7 years (legal requirement), evidence bundle immutable. Ensure hashes/checksums are stored to prove chain-of-custody.

Evan: Implementation notes:
- Presigned URL TTL default 12m; short TTLs reduce leak risk
- Prefer object-store server-side filters (S3 Select) to limit transferred bytes where searches suffice
- For manifest exports break into batches <=1M events per batch to limit single-job blast radius

Riley: Action items:
- Evan: draft KMS key policy + example IAM conditions (due 2025-02-10)
- Riley: RFC for RBAC roles + UI approval flow mockups (due 2025-01-28)
- Marta: add evidence playbook to compliance pack + retention doc updates (due 2025-02-05)
- sre-oncall: runbook edits & test harness for staged exports and throttle behavior (due 2025-01-22)
- audit-bot: schedule follow-ups and attach TASK-8773 to RFC board
